title: Figure 3: Ghost interference position distributions at X2 - two slits vs one slit
description: Two plots of "Coincidence counts" versus "Detector 2 position (mm)" from -8 to 8 mm, with data points and fitted curves. Panel "(a) Two slits" shows a multi-peaked interference "comb" pattern, and panel "(b) One slit" shows a single broad diffraction peak. The caption reads "Figure 3. Ghost Interference Position Distributions at X2."
